statement: Formal single baseline: SegFormer-B0, PCB1 v2 grouped split, seed 42, 50 epochs. Validation is the held-out 132-image split.

scheduler.warmup_is: linear on (completed+1)/warmup_steps; warmup_steps-th update reaches base_lr
scheduler.advanced_by: real optimizer updates only; AMP skips do not advance

training.final_lr_semantics: LR stored after the final update for the next successful update, distinct from last_actual_update_lr.

current_acceptance.scope: Complete matching last epoch only; fail closed on incomplete logs. Legacy report scope corrected and archived.

global.aggregation: sum TP/FP/FN/TN over images, then divide once

predicted_foreground_ratio.percentile_method: numpy linear interpolation over per-image ratios

limitations: Only 12 anomaly images are in validation; sampling uncertainty and multi-seed stability were not quantified.
Global IoU is area-weighted: a few large defects dominate it.
workers=0 is the only validated loader setting; loader waits account for about 34% of training wall time.

New immutable-boundary checks verify exact load state and data sequence; final last-model continuation exceeds declared probability atol=1e-5 and has33 threshold-mask differences. No bounded-numerical or bitwise continuation guarantee.
Legacy formal checkpoint is inference-valid but lacks current strict resume identity and source match; current trainer refuses direct resume.
No test image, mask, prediction or score was used in this stage.

acceptance.note: Original recorded reload_check and identity fields describe historical execution; acceptance-layer evidence is linked separately.
